title: OPNsense Syslog Status Mix
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=opnsense:syslog
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(event_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the OPNsense syslog feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `event_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It always the overall mood of your OPNsense syslog feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
